answer: Harbor isn't one of the lenders in our e-payoff network, so we can't confirm your payoff electronically and you'll need a payoff letter. The letter comes from your lender and must show your account number, the payoff amount, the date it's good through and where to send payment, so ask Harbor for a 15-day payoff amount. If you'd rather not deal with Harbor yourself, sign the lender payoff authorization (form NW-LPA-1) and we'll request the letter for you; allow 2 business days. NW-LPA-1 is only for loans, so if this is a lease, use form NW-LSE-1 instead.
